title: Design WhatsApp Chat System
description: Model 1:1 messaging, group chats, message status, and online presence.

data.text: Design a chat system like WhatsApp. Support 1:1 messages, group chats, message status (sent, delivered, read), and online/offline presence.
Message is an immutable event with sender, content, timestamp, and status. Conversation is either 1:1 (between two users) or group (many users).

data.title: Message and Conversation Models
Why abstract Conversation?
data.text: Direct and group chats share message storage and retrieval but differ in access control. An abstract base lets ChatService work with any conversation type.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Conversation polymorphism handles 1:1 vs group logic
HasAccess enforces privacy at the conversation level
data.takeaway: Chat is a messaging and access-control problem. Keep messages immutable and let Conversation subclasses define who can read them.
